items.title: Luther Henderson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: by this time Pops has done Old Man Satan and he was with the Negro Black Opera Group.

ctx.x: Can you just repeat what you just said?

I said I did that throughout most of the life, my musical life, that I was starting and stopping piano lessons. I remember that the most memorable experiences that I have come through all of that period. I've got to lump it all from the time I'm 4 years old to the time I was 16 as the various things that I seem to have been exposed to by my mother and father too because by this time Pops has done Old Man Satan and he was with the Negro Black Opera Group.
The National Black Negro Opera. No, the National Negro Opera Company.
